evidenceKind: generated ASCII/Binary parser regression scoped to one documented MLEADER leader-line context

sources.name: Autodesk MLeader context DXF reference
sources.use: Defines the context and nested leader scopes, including repeated point-coordinate groups.

sources.name: Autodesk MLeader leader-line DXF reference
sources.use: Identifies groups 10/20/30 as leader-line vertices, and groups 11/21/31 and 12/22/32 as break endpoints.

sources.name: Autodesk common entity group codes
sources.use: Warns that displayed group-code order is not a wire-order guarantee; nested scope boundaries remain significant.

scope.components: Repeated 10/20/30 vertex coordinate arrays only; breaks, flags, same-code occurrence order, and all nested delimiters remain fixed.
scope.limit: Parser-local retention evidence, not full MLEADER style-graph validity, rendering, or CAD acceptance.

reproduction.redControl: Before the fix, the existing focused selector failed for both ASCII and Binary controls because the old parser discarded groups 20/30 arriving before group 10 opened a vertex.
reproduction.validShape: Two asymmetric vertices: repeated group-20 and group-30 arrays precede the repeated group-10 array inside one leader-line block; the nested block closes and entity-level group 270 follows as a parser-state sentinel.
reproduction.negativeControl: An additional group-20 component beyond the X-defined point count is refused at group-305 closure in ASCII and Binary.

implementation.change: DRW_MLeader assigns each vertex coordinate by its independent bounded occurrence ordinal, scoped to the current LEADER_LINE. Group 305 validates X-defined slot count and refuses Y/Z arrays longer than X.
implementation.compatibility: No public field, callback, or virtual changed. Private class layout changed; downstream consumers must rebuild against the updated headers/library.

validation.detail: Existing direct selector; ASCII and Binary exact two-point values, nested closure, post-context group 270, and excess-Y refusal.

limits: No new CTest lane or persistent fixture was added; test records are generated in memory.
No peer runtime, native CAD application, geometry kernel, external drawing, or full suite was run.
No support claim was promoted; this covers only the tested MLEADER leader-line vertex profile.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The worktree remains broadly dirty and .git metadata is read-only; this slice is uncommitted.
